canonical_title: Longitudinal control forces and displacements in takeoff

versions.title_at_revision: Longitudinal control forces and displacements in takeoff
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's longitudinal control force and travel in takeoff meets the standards as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Force and Travel in Takeoff paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the controller forces and travel in takeoff as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Force and Travel in Takeoff paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the flying/handling qualities during a takeoff as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Force and Travel in Takeoff paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the flying/handling qualities during a takeoff as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Force and Travel in Takeoff paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions.
